AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Vanta is a perpetual futures exchange. Its functions only open screens in the app. Operational patterns: - Every function returns a PendingIntent; give it to the user to open Vanta on that screen. - Use 'openFutures' to show a market, its chart, open orders, positions or futures assets. - Use 'prepareFuturesOrder' only when the user asks to set up an order; it fills the order form and never trades. Constraints: - No function places, changes or cancels orders, moves funds, signs or reads balances. Never tell the user an order was placed. - The user always chooses Long or Short, reviews a confirmation and signs inside Vanta. - Markets are USDT-margined perpetuals such as BTCUSDT; a bare asset such as ETH is accepted. - Prices and quantities are plain positive decimals such as 3200.5; quantityUnit 'quote' means USDT.
